Introduction
This report investigates factors associated with employee ratings of their workplace. I will estimate and compare competing linear regression models, evaluate model diagnostics, and interpret the results of a preferred model.

title: Lab 3: Linear Regression — Model Specification, Comparison, and Interpretation
text:
Data

data("attitude", package = "datasets")

analysis_data <- attitude |>
  dplyr::select(rating, complaints, learning, raises)

The analysis uses the built-in R dataset attitude. The analysis dataset has 30 departments and four variables: overall workplace rating (rating), handling of employee complaints (complaints), opportunity to learn (learning), and raises based on performance (raises). The scores represent department-level percentages of favourable employee responses. So, each observation represents a department instead of an individual employee. ## Model Specification
